plan.goal: Reproject the road vector layer from EPSG:4326 (WGS84) to NAD27/UTM Zone 10 (EPSG:26710)
plan.notes: Target CRS is EPSG:26710 (NAD27 / UTM zone 10N). San Francisco lies within UTM Zone 10.

plan.goal: Add a new field named 'Length' to the reprojected road layer containing the geometric length of each feature
plan.notes: Field name must be exactly 'Length'. Length values will be in meters since UTM projection is meter-based.

plan.goal: Count the number of road features where Length is less than 100 meters
plan.notes: Apply filter: Length < 100. Output should be a simple count or summary table with the count of short roads.
